articles.title: How to make Form 127 (old Form 27C)
articles.summary: Fill Form 127, the buyer's declaration under section 394(2): the seller, your details, the goods and the use. Print both copies.

articles.title: How to fill the income tax forms in the official layout
articles.summary: Fill Form 121 (15G/15H), Form 124 (12BB), Form 31 (10BA), Form 97 (Form 60) and other income tax forms in the Income Tax Department layout, then print or save as PDF.

articles.title: Make a declaration for personal use
articles.summary: Make a self declaration, a rent declaration for your employer, or your own wording in the declarations maker. No login, nothing sent anywhere; print or save as PDF.
